group: Round 6 · Loot: item icons and pickup kit (loaded by the game)
title: Item icons: armour
use: Icons for the 18 armours of loot.js (camp_shirt to hermes_cap) and the 6 new armours of loot-design.md (counsellor_vest, lotus_robe, mist_cloak, fury_wings, hellhound_hide, drakon_scale).
prompt: A sheet of 24 game item icons in a grid of 6 columns by 4 rows, one item per 256-pixel cell, read left to right and top to bottom in exactly this order: 1. Camp Half-Blood T-shirt, an orange T-shirt with a small black pegasus; 2. Bronze Breastplate, a plain bronze cuirass; 3. Hermes Express Uniform, a brown courier shirt with a winged-sandal patch; 4. Linothorax, layered white linen armour with shoulder flaps; 5. Biker Jacket of Ares, a black leather biker jacket with a red boar patch; 6. Hunter's Silver Parka, a silver hooded parka with a quiver strap; 7. Sea-Green Mail, sea-green scale mail shimmering like fish scales; 8. Hoplite Panoply, a full bronze cuirass with a crested helm and greaves; 9. Spartan Crimson Cloak, a crimson cloak over bronze shoulders; 10. Satyr's Woven Vest, a vest of living green vines and leaves; 11. Nemean Lion Pelt, a golden lion pelt with the lion's head as a hood; 12. Golden Fleece Mantle, a cloak of shining golden fleece; 13. Fireproof Forge Apron, a heavy leather smith's apron with glowing embers; 14. Armour of the Amazons, sleek dark armour with a bow motif; 15. Armour of Achilles, a magnificent gold-and-bronze cuirass with an engraved shield-like chest; 16. Robe of Hebe, a soft pink-and-white robe with a golden cup emblem; 17. Cloak of the West Wind, a pale blue cloak billowing with swirls of wind; 18. Winged Travelling Cloak, a short traveller's cloak and cap with small white wings; 19. Camp Counsellor Vest, an orange camp vest with pockets and a whistle; 20. Lotus Hotel Bathrobe, a fluffy white bathrobe with a pink lotus flower emblem; 21. Cloak of the Mist, a grey-white cloak that fades into drifting fog at the hem; 22. Wings of the Kindly Ones, a dark leathery cloak shaped like folded bat wings with red trim; 23. Hellhound Hide, a shaggy black hide with glowing red eyes on the hood; 24. Drakon-Scale Plate, armour of big overlapping green-gold dragon scales. Inventory icons in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: each item a small chunky 3D voxel model seen from a high three-quarter angle, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading and a small highlight, a bold silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels, celestial bronze that glows faintly, magic parts with a soft glow. Each icon is centred in its own square cell with even padding and never touches its neighbours; no frame, border, rarity colour, number or label in the cells (the game adds those). The whole sheet sits on a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, texture or cast shadow, so the background can be removed. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
